summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of approximately 231,222 common shares for $5.7 million ($24.79 per share) under subscription agreements with accredited investors, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D. The filing also provides portfolio updates (95% senior secured debt, $1.93B commitments, 9.4% yield). This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No tender offer, restructuring, or strategic change is involved.
